patronOf.en-US: Defender of the Mother of God

prayerExcerpt.en-US: An invincible champion of the divine motherhood of the most Blessed Virgin Mary.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Um invencível defensor da maternidade divina da Bem-aventurada Virgem Maria.

meta.face: An Alexandrian Greek of about sixty with a warm olive complexion and a long, oblong face with a strong frame — a straight, high-bridged nose with a narrow ridge, intense dark eyes under strong, dark, slightly knitted brows angled down toward the nose, high cheekbones, a firm, set mouth; the hair hidden by the cap except a little greying brown at the temples, and a long, full brown beard streaked with grey, tapering to a single point on the chest; a fierce, resolute, watchful look.
meta.basis: Follows the 14th-century fresco in the Chora church, Istanbul (the white cap with crosses, a long tapering brown beard, knitted brows), which agrees with Dionysius's grey-haired, long-bearded Cyril in a cross-marked head-covering, and Tzanes's 1654 icon. The icon of the Theotokos recalls the Council of Ephesus.
